units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 15:11">Targ. Y. I Deut. XV, 11</cite>.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 119a:2-5">Sabb. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>הוה … בשֵׁבְבוּתֵיה</he> there was a gentile in his neighborhood.

<cite ref="Sotah 22a">Sot. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>ההיא אלמנה … בשֵׁיבְבוּתָהּ</he> a widow in whose neighborhood was a synagogue; <he>לא … בשֵׁיבְבוּתָךְ</he> is there no synagogue in thy own neighborhood? <cite ref="Taanit 23b:7">Taan. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>הנהו … בשֵׁיבְבוּתָן</he> (it happened on account) of those lawless people that lived in their neighborhood.
